    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);

                }

                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Upcoming Council Meeting Agendas 2026</h1>
<h2>Next Council Meeting: </h2>
<h3>Monday, 26 October 7.00pm </h3>
<p>This Council Meeting will be held at Frankston City Council Civic Centre 30 Davey Street Frankston and will be open to the public (access via Young Street entrance). The meeting will also be livestreamed to the public (<a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2025/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meetings-on-Monday-2-December"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a>). If you wish to speak on an item on the agenda, please <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting">register here</a> prior to 4.00pm on the day of the Council Meeting.</p>
<p>If you would like to speak to an officer regarding a report listed on the agenda, please contact the Customer Service number <a href="tel:1300322322">1300 322 322</a> or email <a href="mailto:info@frankston.vic.gov.au" target="_blank">info@frankston.vic.gov.au</a>. The name of the officer is listed at the top of the first page of the Council report under enquiries. </p>
<h2>Live Streaming of Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The live streaming of the next Council Meeting will be available via the link below, or via a link provided on <a href="https://www.facebook.com/FrankstonCityCouncil/" target="_self">Council's Facebook page</a> on the night of the meeting.</p>
<p>Live Streaming allows you to watch and listen to the meeting in real time, giving you greater access to Council decision making and debate and improving openness and transparency.</p>
<p>Closed Caption (CC) options are available in the settings section of the streaming site. </p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2026/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meeting-on-Monday-5-October-2026" target="_self"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Submission to Council or Lodge Questions with Notice</h2>
<p>Members of the public wishing to register to make a Submission to Council or lodge Questions with Notice may now do so via the online web forms.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting" target="_self">Request to Speak at a Council Meeting</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Submit-questions-for-council-meetings" target="_self">Submit Question for Question Time</a></li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">To view an archive of past Council Meeting live streams, agendas, minutes and supporting information, please visit the <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Past-Council-Meeting-Agendas-and-Minutes">Past Council Meeting Agendas and Minutes page</a>.</span></p>

        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });

                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {

                    }
                }, 0);

                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }

                    return;
                }

        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });

                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {

                    }

                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }

                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);

                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');

                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();

                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }

                }

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        (function () {

            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {

                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }

                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();

                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }

      const token = "738cefbd-19ea-47bd-9c7d-1dc010e3208e";

      const now = Math.floor(new Date().getTime()/1000);
      const timedout = (now-cookie_timeout);
      let setTime, setHours;

      if (!String.format) {
        String.format = function(format) {
          var args = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments, 1);

        };

      if (isNaN(readCookie("setTime")) || readCookie("setTime") == "undefined") clearCookies();
      else if (parseInt(readCookie) < timedout) clearCookies();

      const officeHours = async () => {
        let setHours;
        if (readCookie('setHours') === "undefined" || readCookie('setTime') === "undefined" || parseInt(readCookie('setTime')) < timedout) {
          console.debug('resetting cookies');
          delay();
          const response = await fetch(
            String.format('{0}?basickey={1}&company={2}&route_template={3}',
            APIURL, basickey, company, route_template)

          writeCookie('setHours', setHours);

          setHours = readCookie('setHours');
          console.debug('preserving cookies');
        }
        writeCookie('setTime', now);
        console.debug(`officeHours returning ${setHours}`);
        return `${route_template}${setHours}`;

      function writeCookie(key,value) { $.cookie(key, value); }

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

        let setHours;
        if (readCookie('setHours') === "undefined" || readCookie('setTime') === "undefined" || parseInt(readCookie('setTime')) < timedout) {
          console.debug('resetting cookies');
          delay();
          const response = await fetch(
            String.format('{0}?basickey={1}&company={2}&route_template={3}',
            APIURL, basickey, company, route_template)
          );
          const rtnval = await response.json();
          setHours = (rtnval.data.status == "open") ? "inhours" : "afterhours";
          writeCookie('setHours', setHours);
        }else{
          setHours = readCookie('setHours');
          console.debug('preserving cookies');
        }
        writeCookie('setTime', now);
        console.debug(`officeHours returning ${setHours}`);
        return `${route_template}${setHours}`;
      }

      function readCookie(key) { return $.cookie(key); }

      function writeCookie(key,value) { $.cookie(key, value); }

        writeCookie('setTime','undefined');
        writeCookie('setHours','undefined');

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }

                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }

                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {

                    }

                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {

                }

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();

                }

        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });

                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {

                    }
                }, 0);

                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }

                    return;
                }

                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);

                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');

                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();

                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }

                    return false;
                }

                }

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Upcoming Council Meeting Agendas 2026</h1>
<h2>Next Council Meeting: </h2>
<h3>Monday, 26 October 7.00pm </h3>
<p>This Council Meeting will be held at Frankston City Council Civic Centre 30 Davey Street Frankston and will be open to the public (access via Young Street entrance). The meeting will also be livestreamed to the public (<a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2025/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meetings-on-Monday-2-December"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a>). If you wish to speak on an item on the agenda, please <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting">register here</a> prior to 4.00pm on the day of the Council Meeting.</p>
<p>If you would like to speak to an officer regarding a report listed on the agenda, please contact the Customer Service number <a href="tel:1300322322">1300 322 322</a> or email <a href="mailto:info@frankston.vic.gov.au" target="_blank">info@frankston.vic.gov.au</a>. The name of the officer is listed at the top of the first page of the Council report under enquiries. </p>
<h2>Live Streaming of Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The live streaming of the next Council Meeting will be available via the link below, or via a link provided on <a href="https://www.facebook.com/FrankstonCityCouncil/" target="_self">Council's Facebook page</a> on the night of the meeting.</p>
<p>Live Streaming allows you to watch and listen to the meeting in real time, giving you greater access to Council decision making and debate and improving openness and transparency.</p>
<p>Closed Caption (CC) options are available in the settings section of the streaming site. </p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2026/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meeting-on-Monday-5-October-2026" target="_self"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Submission to Council or Lodge Questions with Notice</h2>
<p>Members of the public wishing to register to make a Submission to Council or lodge Questions with Notice may now do so via the online web forms.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting" target="_self">Request to Speak at a Council Meeting</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Submit-questions-for-council-meetings" target="_self">Submit Question for Question Time</a></li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">To view an archive of past Council Meeting live streams, agendas, minutes and supporting information, please visit the <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Past-Council-Meeting-Agendas-and-Minutes">Past Council Meeting Agendas and Minutes page</a>.</span></p>

        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });

                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {

                    }
                }, 0);

                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {

                }
            }, true);

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Upcoming Council Meeting Agendas 2026</h1>
<h2>Next Council Meeting: </h2>
<h3>Monday, 26 October 7.00pm </h3>
<p>This Council Meeting will be held at Frankston City Council Civic Centre 30 Davey Street Frankston and will be open to the public (access via Young Street entrance). The meeting will also be livestreamed to the public (<a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2025/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meetings-on-Monday-2-December"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a>). If you wish to speak on an item on the agenda, please <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting">register here</a> prior to 4.00pm on the day of the Council Meeting.</p>
<p>If you would like to speak to an officer regarding a report listed on the agenda, please contact the Customer Service number <a href="tel:1300322322">1300 322 322</a> or email <a href="mailto:info@frankston.vic.gov.au" target="_blank">info@frankston.vic.gov.au</a>. The name of the officer is listed at the top of the first page of the Council report under enquiries. </p>
<h2>Live Streaming of Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The live streaming of the next Council Meeting will be available via the link below, or via a link provided on <a href="https://www.facebook.com/FrankstonCityCouncil/" target="_self">Council's Facebook page</a> on the night of the meeting.</p>
<p>Live Streaming allows you to watch and listen to the meeting in real time, giving you greater access to Council decision making and debate and improving openness and transparency.</p>
<p>Closed Caption (CC) options are available in the settings section of the streaming site. </p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2026/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meeting-on-Monday-5-October-2026" target="_self"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Submission to Council or Lodge Questions with Notice</h2>
<p>Members of the public wishing to register to make a Submission to Council or lodge Questions with Notice may now do so via the online web forms.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting" target="_self">Request to Speak at a Council Meeting</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Submit-questions-for-council-meetings" target="_self">Submit Question for Question Time</a></li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">To view an archive of past Council Meeting live streams, agendas, minutes and supporting information, please visit the <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Past-Council-Meeting-Agendas-and-Minutes">Past Council Meeting Agendas and Minutes page</a>.</span></p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Upcoming Council Meeting Agendas 2026</h1>
<h2>Next Council Meeting: </h2>
<h3>Monday, 26 October 7.00pm </h3>
<p>This Council Meeting will be held at Frankston City Council Civic Centre 30 Davey Street Frankston and will be open to the public (access via Young Street entrance). The meeting will also be livestreamed to the public (<a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2025/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meetings-on-Monday-2-December"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a>). If you wish to speak on an item on the agenda, please <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting">register here</a> prior to 4.00pm on the day of the Council Meeting.</p>
<p>If you would like to speak to an officer regarding a report listed on the agenda, please contact the Customer Service number <a href="tel:1300322322">1300 322 322</a> or email <a href="mailto:info@frankston.vic.gov.au" target="_blank">info@frankston.vic.gov.au</a>. The name of the officer is listed at the top of the first page of the Council report under enquiries. </p>
<h2>Live Streaming of Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The live streaming of the next Council Meeting will be available via the link below, or via a link provided on <a href="https://www.facebook.com/FrankstonCityCouncil/" target="_self">Council's Facebook page</a> on the night of the meeting.</p>
<p>Live Streaming allows you to watch and listen to the meeting in real time, giving you greater access to Council decision making and debate and improving openness and transparency.</p>
<p>Closed Caption (CC) options are available in the settings section of the streaming site. </p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2026/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meeting-on-Monday-5-October-2026" target="_self"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Submission to Council or Lodge Questions with Notice</h2>
<p>Members of the public wishing to register to make a Submission to Council or lodge Questions with Notice may now do so via the online web forms.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting" target="_self">Request to Speak at a Council Meeting</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Submit-questions-for-council-meetings" target="_self">Submit Question for Question Time</a></li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">To view an archive of past Council Meeting live streams, agendas, minutes and supporting information, please visit the <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Past-Council-Meeting-Agendas-and-Minutes">Past Council Meeting Agendas and Minutes page</a>.</span></p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Upcoming Council Meeting Agendas 2026</h1>
<h2>Next Council Meeting: </h2>
<h3>Monday, 26 October 7.00pm </h3>
<p>This Council Meeting will be held at Frankston City Council Civic Centre 30 Davey Street Frankston and will be open to the public (access via Young Street entrance). The meeting will also be livestreamed to the public (<a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2025/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meetings-on-Monday-2-December"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a>). If you wish to speak on an item on the agenda, please <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting">register here</a> prior to 4.00pm on the day of the Council Meeting.</p>
<p>If you would like to speak to an officer regarding a report listed on the agenda, please contact the Customer Service number <a href="tel:1300322322">1300 322 322</a> or email <a href="mailto:info@frankston.vic.gov.au" target="_blank">info@frankston.vic.gov.au</a>. The name of the officer is listed at the top of the first page of the Council report under enquiries. </p>
<h2>Live Streaming of Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The live streaming of the next Council Meeting will be available via the link below, or via a link provided on <a href="https://www.facebook.com/FrankstonCityCouncil/" target="_self">Council's Facebook page</a> on the night of the meeting.</p>
<p>Live Streaming allows you to watch and listen to the meeting in real time, giving you greater access to Council decision making and debate and improving openness and transparency.</p>
<p>Closed Caption (CC) options are available in the settings section of the streaming site. </p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2026/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meeting-on-Monday-5-October-2026" target="_self"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a></p>
</li>
</ul>

<p>Members of the public wishing to register to make a Submission to Council or lodge Questions with Notice may now do so via the online web forms.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting" target="_self">Request to Speak at a Council Meeting</a></li>

</ul>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Upcoming Council Meeting Agendas 2026</h1>
<h2>Next Council Meeting: </h2>
<h3>Monday, 26 October 7.00pm </h3>
<p>This Council Meeting will be held at Frankston City Council Civic Centre 30 Davey Street Frankston and will be open to the public (access via Young Street entrance). The meeting will also be livestreamed to the public (<a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2025/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meetings-on-Monday-2-December"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a>). If you wish to speak on an item on the agenda, please <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting">register here</a> prior to 4.00pm on the day of the Council Meeting.</p>
<p>If you would like to speak to an officer regarding a report listed on the agenda, please contact the Customer Service number <a href="tel:1300322322">1300 322 322</a> or email <a href="mailto:info@frankston.vic.gov.au" target="_blank">info@frankston.vic.gov.au</a>. The name of the officer is listed at the top of the first page of the Council report under enquiries. </p>
<h2>Live Streaming of Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The live streaming of the next Council Meeting will be available via the link below, or via a link provided on <a href="https://www.facebook.com/FrankstonCityCouncil/" target="_self">Council's Facebook page</a> on the night of the meeting.</p>
<p>Live Streaming allows you to watch and listen to the meeting in real time, giving you greater access to Council decision making and debate and improving openness and transparency.</p>
<p>Closed Caption (CC) options are available in the settings section of the streaming site. </p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2026/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meeting-on-Monday-5-October-2026" target="_self"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a></p>
</li>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Upcoming Council Meeting Agendas 2026</h1>
<h2>Next Council Meeting: </h2>
<h3>Monday, 26 October 7.00pm </h3>
<p>This Council Meeting will be held at Frankston City Council Civic Centre 30 Davey Street Frankston and will be open to the public (access via Young Street entrance). The meeting will also be livestreamed to the public (<a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2025/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meetings-on-Monday-2-December"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a>). If you wish to speak on an item on the agenda, please <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting">register here</a> prior to 4.00pm on the day of the Council Meeting.</p>
<p>If you would like to speak to an officer regarding a report listed on the agenda, please contact the Customer Service number <a href="tel:1300322322">1300 322 322</a> or email <a href="mailto:info@frankston.vic.gov.au" target="_blank">info@frankston.vic.gov.au</a>. The name of the officer is listed at the top of the first page of the Council report under enquiries. </p>
<h2>Live Streaming of Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The live streaming of the next Council Meeting will be available via the link below, or via a link provided on <a href="https://www.facebook.com/FrankstonCityCouncil/" target="_self">Council's Facebook page</a> on the night of the meeting.</p>
<p>Live Streaming allows you to watch and listen to the meeting in real time, giving you greater access to Council decision making and debate and improving openness and transparency.</p>
<p>Closed Caption (CC) options are available in the settings section of the streaming site. </p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2026/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meeting-on-Monday-5-October-2026" target="_self"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a></p>
</li>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Upcoming Council Meeting Agendas 2026</h1>
<h2>Next Council Meeting: </h2>
<h3>Monday, 26 October 7.00pm </h3>
<p>This Council Meeting will be held at Frankston City Council Civic Centre 30 Davey Street Frankston and will be open to the public (access via Young Street entrance). The meeting will also be livestreamed to the public (<a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2025/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meetings-on-Monday-2-December"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a>). If you wish to speak on an item on the agenda, please <a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Council-Meetings/Request-to-Speak-at-a-Council-Meeting">register here</a> prior to 4.00pm on the day of the Council Meeting.</p>
<p>If you would like to speak to an officer regarding a report listed on the agenda, please contact the Customer Service number <a href="tel:1300322322">1300 322 322</a> or email <a href="mailto:info@frankston.vic.gov.au" target="_blank">info@frankston.vic.gov.au</a>. The name of the officer is listed at the top of the first page of the Council report under enquiries. </p>
<h2>Live Streaming of Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The live streaming of the next Council Meeting will be available via the link below, or via a link provided on <a href="https://www.facebook.com/FrankstonCityCouncil/" target="_self">Council's Facebook page</a> on the night of the meeting.</p>
<p>Live Streaming allows you to watch and listen to the meeting in real time, giving you greater access to Council decision making and debate and improving openness and transparency.</p>
<p>Closed Caption (CC) options are available in the settings section of the streaming site. </p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.frankston.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-and-committee-meetings/Upcoming-Council-Meeting-Agendas-2026/Live-Streaming-of-Council-Meeting-on-Monday-5-October-2026" target="_self"><strong>View live streams of Council Meetings</strong></a></p>
</li>
